{"claims":[{"claim_text":"The Bush Administration and the Republican Congress have made efforts to help the people of Darfur, in western Sudan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Brutal militias in western Sudan are causing immense human suffering.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"American assistance has been provided for famine relief, assistance for refugees, and other humanitarian aid in Sudan.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"No amount of aid can substitute for true and lasting peace in Sudan.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Government of Sudan must stop the violence of Janjaweed militias.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"All parties in Sudan must respect the cease-fire and allow the free movement of humanitarian workers and supplies.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"There is hope for peace for the people of Sudan and for normalization of relations between Sudan and the United States.",
"claim_types":["prediction"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"The Government of Sudan must not remain complicit in the brutalization of Darfur.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[1]},{"claim_text":"Republicans deplore the Government of Zimbabwe's refusal to adhere to the rule of law.",
"claim_types":["evaluation"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"The Bush Administration has rightly condemned the Government of Zimbabwe's assaults against human rights.",
"claim_types":["factual_assertion"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for the President's decision to suspend non-humanitarian aid to Zimbabwe.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]},{"claim_text":"Support for imposing targeted sanctions on the Zimbabwean regime and its supporters.",
"claim_types":["policy_position"],"evidence_ids":[2]}],"unresolved_references":[]}
```
